items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: If they’ve got Kid Ory and Barney Bigard playing and Claude Hopkins for Christ’s sake playing on those Ma Rainey records.

ctx.x: If they’ve got Kid Ory and Barney Bigard playing and Claude Hopkins for Christ’s sake playing on those Ma Rainey records. Give me a break you know. That’s just collectors’ wish fulfillment you know.
Yeah because, “Oh that’s a Claude Hopkins lick,” but as you already stated, these licks man are traded all over.
